glosses: colony (geographical area under the remote control of a country)
colony (group of people who settle an area and maintain ties to their country of origin)
colony (group of people with similar interests, occupations or characteristics, living in a particular area)

examples.text: Uma parte do país foi, em tempos, uma colónia francesa.
examples.en: A part of the country was at one time a French settlement.

examples.text: O Brasil foi uma colónia portuguesa.
